# Unicode 18.0.0 normalization test

`NormalizationTest.txt` is the Normalization Test Suite of the Unicode Character Database 18.0.0
(`NormalizationTest-18.0.0.txt`, dated 2026-06-24 in its header), published at
https://www.unicode.org/Public/18.0.0/ucd/NormalizationTest.txt under the Unicode License v3. It is
test data of this repository only and is not packaged with the crate. `SHA256SUMS` records its
SHA-256, `25a50d816764b04abfb4a646d3eb2b2a803284c3873d9a06757b94fe4513dde3`.

On 2026-10-27 the file was downloaded from that address and compared byte for byte with this copy:
they are identical.
